See also: Vagin and vagin-

Catalan

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central) [ˈba.ʒin]
  • IPA(key): (Balearic) [ˈva.ʒin]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [ˈva.d͡ʒin]

Verb

[edit]

vagin

  1. inflection of anar:
    1. third-person plural present subjunctive
    2. third-person plural imperative
  2. (auxiliary, with infinitive) third-person plural present subjunctive of anar

French

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • vagine

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin vāgīna. Compare the inherited doublet gaine. Compare also gouine, which may be borrowed from Breton gouin, itself ultimately borrowed from the Latin. (Can this(+) etymology be sourced?) Also a doublet of gaine (“sheath”), which was inherited from the Latin.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /va.ʒɛ̃/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio (France (Paris)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)

Noun

[edit]

vagin m (plural vagins)

  1. vagina
    Synonyms: see Thesaurus:vagin

Related terms

[edit]
  • vaginal

Descendants

[edit]
  • → Persian: واژن (vâžan)
  • → Romanian: vagin

Further reading

[edit]
  • “vagin”, in Trésor de la langue française informatisé [Digitized Treasury of the French Language], 2012

Romanian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French vagin, Latin vagina.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [vaˈd͡ʒin]

Noun

[edit]

vagin n (plural vagine)

  1. (anatomy) vagina
    Synonym: (euphemistic) păsărică

Declension

[edit]
singular plural
indefinite definite indefinite definite
nominative-accusative vagin vaginul vagine vaginele
genitive-dative vagin vaginului vagine vaginelor
vocative vaginule vaginelor

Related terms

[edit]
  • vaginal

Further reading

[edit]
  • “vagin”, in DEX online—Dicționare ale limbii române (Dictionaries of the Romanian language) (in Romanian), 2004–2026
